# Publish and qualify protected browser ABI

Depends on #826 and #827 PASS/upstream. #825's native owner, additive records/queries/receipts, private protected staged boot, Unsupported guards and protected stream start/stop are a pushed baseline, but #825 is stopped/superseded for attempt accounting. This issue owns one closable publication outcome: expose public protected boot after all alias transactions are verified, generate the complete additive ABI layout/export vocabulary from Rust, refresh the checked-in SDK ABI assets, and qualify one actual shipped simd128 AudioWorklet Wasm artifact with scalar Wasm cargo-check evidence. Browser receiver/sender/subscription/app behavioral adoption is a later issue.

## Scope and frozen contract

Allowed production: `hosts/host-web/src/ffi.rs` (public boot forwarding the existing private transaction) and minimal `lib.rs` visibility/constants needed by the generator; `tools/parameter-metadata/src/abi_layout.rs` and existing layout tests; `scripts/check-abi-layout-v1.py`, `scripts/check-web-audioworklet.sh` and their existing self-tests; the normal source-derived generated `sdk/assets/miso-engine-v1-abi-layout.json`, `sdk/src/generated/abi.ts`/provenance, and only mechanical declaration compatibility in `sdk/src/browser/shipped-host.d.ts`; the existing source-derived artifact hash pin. Include another existing frozen export gate only if its exact vocabulary requires the additive names. No new generator, general SDK reader cleanup, benchmarking framework, JS worklet receiver/sender behavior, subscription owner, app/frontend, FFT or second artifact.

Public `miso_engine_web_v1_boot_with_observation_demand(len)` forwards the already tested private protected boot transaction and cannot fall back to Legacy on malformed nested headers, reserved fields, padded target IDs or explicit limits. Preserve every old C-ABI record size, numeric result, exported spelling and symbol. Generate all eight additive observation record layouts, every nested leaf via summed actual Rust `offset_of!`, and explicit non-semantic alignment-padding byte rows derived from adjacent offsets. The independent Python validator still enforces complete nonoverlapping tiling. Generate all 17 additive exports including protected boot in lexical order and canonical profile/operation/domain/state/flag/refusal vocabulary; no hand-written JavaScript offsets. Generate checked-in JSON/TypeScript once at a coherent boundary through existing tooling. The Wasm module's actual exports/layouts must agree with generated metadata and the pinned artifact bytes.

## Objective gates

- Actual public protected boot → Pending spectrum start → real Applied application receipt → nonzero raw PCM and response capture with matching native identities → reserved/repeated stop → terminal status/application handoff; malformed exact/one-below budgets and nested header/reserved/ID cases refuse without Legacy fallback. Preserve legacy boot.
- Source-derived records decode actual Rust widths/offsets, including nested leaves and the real ingress alignment hole. `u64` owner/generation/selection/token/limit values above `2^53` round-trip exactly through generated offsets/BigInt. Old records/constants/exports remain byte-for-byte and numerically unchanged. Validator self-test red mutations catch missing/wrong-width fields, bad padding and missing exports.
- Locked native check and focused/full host-web tests; parameter-metadata generator `--check`; SDK generated/layout/type gates; wasm32 scalar cargo check and simd128 cargo check/build; actual artifact export/layout/opcode/callgraph/resource gate with one source-derived regenerated hash pin; proportional realtime/allocation gate; format/diff. Use `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/bl/misofm/engine/target`. Do not retry/tune descriptive benchmarks.

## Delivery and evidence record

At most four coherent issue-wide implementation rounds: fresh Luna MAX rounds 1–2, Sol HIGH round 3 if needed, Astra XHIGH round 4 if needed. Each gets one independent fresh Astra MEDIUM adversarial verdict; fixture-only revisions count. After round four FAIL, stop and rebrief. Each fresh implementer receives a small compiling, testable scope with only this stateless issue and exact source pointers; root commits each exact-path green or candid useful recovery tranche before layering another and synchronizes pushed evidence/GitHub. A round's adversarial verdict assesses the coherent candidate for this publication contract; checkpoint letters cannot reset its attempt ledger. Record hashes, source/export/layout hash and generated diff, actual Wasm artifact hash/gate output, lifecycle/BigInt fixtures, exact commands/results, reviewer verdict and remaining findings here. If behavioral SDK/browser wiring becomes required, split it immediately into the adoption issue rather than expanding this contract.

Decision/evidence: pending implementation round 1.
